## Cyrus creature pipeline (R3)

Branch `feature/cyrus-r6` (from `feature/cyrus-r2`), 2026-10-10. MASTER-PLAN 2 (banshee on 1.21.x = sounds on a vanilla mob; animated creatures 26.x first), 2b (host seam), 4.5, 4.7 (Models), R3; GAPS finding 6 + B9; research `B-models.md`, `A-content.md`. **Nothing is deployed or switched on.** Creatures are OFF behind `CYRUS_CREATURES=1` (portal: plan + request; worker: delivery) and, for delivery, the existing `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1`; unset = fail closed (the request says "not switched on yet", nothing touches a server). 26.x is still not buildable in the shipped registry, so even with the flag on nothing is offered until the owner marks a 26.x version buildable. No real model build ran (no paid AI): the build service was exercised with the fake CLI. **No real Minecraft client connected anywhere: how the creatures LOOK and ANIMATE for a player, the pack download and the accept prompt are NOT verified.**

**The flow.** Build request (plan gate kind `model` = top plan, version capability `animatedCreatures` + buildable, the flag) -> the build service's AI writes a RigSpec `assets/creatures/<name>.json` (template form recommended) + plugin code that spawns a silent, invisible vanilla base mob and attaches the model through the BetterModel API (compile-only, on the javac classpath) -> the service validates the spec with the generated validator (bounded repairs, drop-don't-ship) -> the portal re-validates, **compiles** the RigSpec to a Blockbench `.bbmodel` (format 5.0) + skin PNG + baked keyframes, runs the skin quality bar, records a revision + `CyrusProjectAsset` kind `model` -> (worker, flags on) Nxeon ensures the managed **BetterModel 3.5.0** plugin, writes its managed config and `plugins/BetterModel/models/<namespace>_<name>.bbmodel` -> restart: BetterModel builds its own resource pack (`plugins/BetterModel/build.zip`) -> the hand-off normalises it, hosts it by sha1 and adds ONE server-level Pack Loader entry next to each mod's own pack.

### 1. BetterModel as a managed plugin (`lib/cyrus/managed/`)
- **Pinned release 3.5.0** (GitHub release `3.5.0`, 2026-09-20, branch v3; asset `bettermodel-3.5.0-paper.jar`, 2,449,528 bytes, **sha256 `0f983569b45e82f657fd6267f68115cc679fa066f0e8eec2ce328596dcb57ed6`** = GitHub's asset digest = our download). Licence **MIT** (GitHub licence API, `LICENSE.md`). README (v3 branch): Minecraft **1.21.4 ~ 26.3.x, Java 25+**; jar: `paper-plugin.yml` (api-version 1.21.4, loader `BetterModelLoader`), classes major **69** (Java 25), NMS adapters v1_21_R3..v26_R3. v2 (Java 21, 1.21.x) is stale and not used.
- `catalog.json` entry `bettermodel@26` (data; **no 1.21 pin**, so `pinFor` fails closed with `no_pin` on 1.21.x), `source: url`, `artifact bettermodel/bettermodel-3.5.0-paper.jar`, `javaRelease 25`, `licence`, `runtimeLibraries`, `managedConfig`. `seedCatalog` now writes 3 rows. Installer and ref-counting are the R0 ones unchanged (`ensureManagedPlugin` / `releaseManagedPlugin`, dependents `project:<id>`; real install still OFF behind `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL`). The Mods engine accepts `paper-plugin.yml` jars.

|---|---|---|---|

| malformed: + truncated JSON, wrong shape, empty file | passed 6/6: BetterModel logs `Unable to load this model: <key>` at WARN for each (empty: null ModelData; the others: `Unable to parse this json asset`), the three good models load, spawn works, server unaffected | 12.4 s | 807 MB |
| perf: vanilla / BetterModel only / ramp 1 -> 10 -> 50 | all passed; see below | 13.8 / 13.7 / 12.4 s | 742 / 786 / 826 MB |

Performance (no player connected): BetterModel + its libraries add about **+40 MB RSS and +1-3 s boot** (plugin load 159-166 ms after the first start; the first start also relocates the libraries). - Two RigSpec forms (template recommended, explicit for anything else) and `zod/mini` for the shared validator; the expanded spec drops `template`, the stored/returned spec keeps the small template form.
- `.bbmodel` format 5.0 (BetterModel 3.5.0 reads 4.10 and 5.0; its own demo models are both); bone tags `hi_` / `glow_`; death clip `hold` so it does not snap back before the plugin removes the mob; every death ends with a shrink to 2 %.
- Model key `<namespace>_<name>` as the file name; Nxeon writes models into `plugins/BetterModel/models` (not shipped inside the plugin jar) and removes only its own prefix.
- BetterModel's pack is hosted as ONE server-level entry (`nx_bmodel00`/`bettermodel`) after a deterministic re-zip; the mod's own pack keeps textures/sounds.
- A creature request also requests sounds; on 1.21.x the creature is a downgrade with the owner's wording, the sound set still builds.
- Managed config changes (metrics, version check, player animation, merge) as above; an owner-edited config is never overwritten.

### Owner actions
1. Decide whether Nxeon pre-places BetterModel's runtime libraries on customer servers (pinned, from `bettermodel-3.5.0.libraries.json`) or lets the plugin download them on first start (needs outbound internet to Google's Maven mirror and maven.blamejared.com).

3. A real-client test day on 26.2: see the three creatures, their idle/walk/attack/hurt/death, the pack prompt and the sounds; then measure per-viewer cost with N creatures and set the budget.
4. Mark a 26.x version buildable (R0 lane), then `CYRUS_CREATURES=1` (portal + worker) and, with the R0 steps done, `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1`.
5. Wire the hand-off trigger (after the restart that a creature delivery requires) and choose `required` for the BetterModel pack (default false).

Verified: first and second boot normalise to the same pack (sha1 `39acdb7c...ef9e` for the 3 fixtures), a second hand-off is `unchanged`, and the Pack Loader on a real server accepted the resulting `packs.json` next to BetterModel. Not wired into a worker job yet (it must run AFTER the restart that follows a delivery): the owner/next slice decides the trigger (worker step after a restart, or a `/bettermodel reload` + read).
- **Compile-only API** (`lib/cyrus/import/deps.json`, version `cyrus-import-deps-2026-10-10.2`): `bettermodel-api` (`io.github.toxicity188:bettermodel-api:3.5.0`, 584,744 bytes, sha256 `40250544...8874`) and `bettermodel-bukkit-api` (18,628 bytes, sha256 `447fd5b1...37b9`) from Maven Central (sha1 matched), MIT, never shaded; `javap`: no API class references `kotlin/*` (the plugin's relocated Kotlin cannot leak). The build service puts both on the javac classpath of creature builds (`creatures.js CREATURE_DEPS`, verified sha256 on every compile, like imports); imports may use them too (they need a 26.x target: class major 69).
- Tool: `services/modbuilder/tools/bettermodel/fetch-bettermodel.js <repo> <out>` downloads + verifies the jar (catalog sha256) and both library seeds (ledger sha256) into `<out>/bettermodel/...` and `<out>/seeds/bettermodel-3.5.0-{paper-libraries,libby}`.

### 2. RigSpec v1 (`lib/cyrus/creature/spec.ts`, `templates.ts`, `rigspec.v1.schema.json`)
- Zod (**`zod/mini`**, so the bundled service copy is 51 KB instead of 354 KB) + plain checks. `checkRigSpec(raw, { namespace })` never throws: `{ ok, spec (expanded, self-validating), warnings, stats }` or `{ ok: false, error, errors[] }`. JSON Schema regenerated with the artifacts script; the service copy `services/modbuilder/creature-spec.js` is GENERATED (`npx tsx scripts/cyrus/build-creature-artifacts.ts [--check]`; a test fails when stale and runs TS vs JS on every fixture/negative case).
- Fields: `version 1`, `name`, `displayName?`, `archetype` (humanoid | quadruped | flyer | floating_ghost), **template form** `template: { features, height 0.7-1.5 }` OR explicit `bones` + `animations`, `scale 0.4-3`, `hitbox {width, height}` (the base mob's box, blocks), `baseEntity` (18 allowed vanilla mobs), `skin { size? 64|128, palette 2-16 colours }`, `sounds { ambient?, hurt?, death?, attack?, step?, spawn? }` = sound-slice keys `<namespace>:<set>.<event>` (namespace must be the project's).
- Bones: name, parent (exactly one root, acyclic, depth <= 6), pivot, rest rotation, `tag` head (BetterModel `hi_` = follows the look, with children) | glow (`glow_` + light_emission 15) | none, cubes `{from, to, material, shade solid|fade + fadeTo, inflate 0-1, decals per face}`; decals `px/rect/line` in face-local pixels, checked to lie inside their face. Clips: idle + walk (loop), attack + hurt + death (once; death compiles to `hold`), up to 3 extra; tracks per bone/channel (rotation | position | scale) as `wave {amp, offset, cycles (whole), phase}` or `keys [{t 0..1, v, ease}]` (start 0, end 1, increasing; a looping key track must close).
- Cost guards: 32 bones, 64 cubes (12 per bone), 8 clips, 32 tracks/clip, 12 keys/track, 24 decals/face, 160 total, coordinates +-64, cube sides 0.2-48, 4 creatures per mod, 48 KB per spec. Soft warnings (never block): hitbox vs model height, no head bone, missing hurt/death/attack sound.
- **Templates** (hand-tuned, `templates.ts`): `floating_ghost` (palette skin, robe, shadow, hair, eye, mouth; features hood, crown, claws; 10 bones: tapered robe skirt -> tail -> wisp chain, long hair + side strands, glowing eyes, wailing mouth, thin clawed arms; floats with a bob), `humanoid` (skin, cloth, cloth_dark, accent, hair, eye; horns, hood, cape; root at the feet so death falls flat), `quadruped` (fur, fur_dark, belly, nose, eye, accent; horns, mane, spikes; diagonal-gait walk, bite lunge, topples sideways). Flyer has no template (explicit form only).

### 3. Compiler (`lib/cyrus/creature/compile.ts`, `quality.ts`, `preview.ts`, `portal.ts`)
- `compileCreature(spec, namespace)` -> `.bbmodel` JSON (format 5.0, `model_format free`, per-face UVs, groups + outliner tree, embedded PNG, animations with animators keyed by group UUID), skin TextureSpec, PNG, layout, stats. UUIDs are derived (`stableUuid`, sha256 of compiler + key + path), so output is byte-identical; golden hashes in `test/fixtures/cyrus-creatures/golden.json` (`scripts/cyrus/creature-golden.ts`). Compiler version `rig-c1`.
- Skin: box-UV net per cube (Minecraft/Blockbench layout, faces share edges), shelf-packed onto the smallest 64/128 sheet; painted as a texture-pipeline TextureSpec with the new **skin profile** of the DSL (`checkSpec(raw, { profile: "skin" })`: sizes 64/128, 3,000 ops, 96 colours; the item profile and its limits are unchanged and stay the default) and rendered by the same deterministic renderer: top faces lighter, bottoms darker, sides base or a 4-band stepped fade, a darker 1 px bottom rim, then decals. Skin quality `sk-1`: every used texel opaque (fail), no semi-transparent pixels (fail), palette <= 64/96 (warn/fail above), contrast >= 3 (warn 2-3, fail < 2). A failing skin is dropped, never shipped.
- Animations baked: waves at 8 samples per cycle (catmull-rom, last key = first so loops are seamless), key tracks as written (linear or catmull-rom), position scaled with `scale`.
- Review renderer: `previewSheet` (orthographic software rasteriser of the textured cuboids with Blockbench's ZYX bone transforms; 3x3 contact sheet: front, 3/4, side, back, idle, walk, attack wind-up/strike, death) and `skinSheetPng`; `scripts/cyrus/creature-preview.ts <out> <specs...>`. The template previews were looked at and iterated (see "Quality" below).

### 4. Build service + portal

The section (only then; the prompt is byte-identical otherwise) explains the template form (templates, palette keys, features), the explicit form, base mobs, sound keys, the exact API calls (`world.spawn(..., mob -> { mob.setSilent(true); mob.setInvisible(true); })`, `BetterModel.model("<namespace>_<name>").map(r -> r.create(BukkitAdapter.adapt(mob)))`, `animate("idle")`, `animate("attack", AnimationModifier.DEFAULT_WITH_PLAY_ONCE, ...)`, `damageTint()`, re-attach with `getOrCreate` in `EntitiesLoadEvent`, `close()` on removal and in `onDisable`), `depend: [BetterModel]` and the howToUse lines (resource pack, Bedrock). Workspace allow-list + keep rule like textures/sounds; `checkWorkspaceCreatures` (hard: JSON/spec/name/count; soft once: model attached, model key used, sounds played, `setSilent`/`setInvisible`, `depend: [BetterModel]`); `assetResult.creatures [{name, path, sha256, spec}]` (the spec as written); `ASSET_PROMPT_VERSION mb-assets-2026-10-10.3`; `/health features.assets` lists `creature` only when possible; creature builds are never deduped. Dockerfile copies `creatures.js`, `creature-spec.js`, `creature-example.json`; with `deps.json` next to it the image fetches the BetterModel API jars too.
- **Portal**: build kind `creature` (`lib/cyrus/assets/kinds.ts`); `planBuildAssets` gates it as `model` (top plan; keep/install never gated), then version: no `animatedCreatures` (all 1.21.x) -> **"Animated custom creatures need Minecraft 26.x; on this version Cyrus can build the plugin with custom sounds (and a static item-style model later), on a vanilla-looking mob."**, a 26.x version that is not buildable -> says so, flag off -> "not switched on in Cyrus yet". A creature request also requests sounds (the base mob is silenced), so Saka/top plans still get the banshee's sound set on 1.21.x. Router: the `entity_model` rule now carries the model asset kind (build kind `creature`), an `info` limit naming the Nxeon-managed BetterModel, the pack and Bedrock, and `requiresCapability animatedCreatures` as a **downgrade (warn)**, never a block or a client-mod claim (new optional `downgrade` flag on route rules). Registry: capability `animatedCreatures` on 26.1.2 / 26.2 / 26.3 (only 26.2 flown).
- **Sync** (`lib/cyrus/assets/sync.ts` + `lib/cyrus/creature/portal.ts`): re-validate + compile + skin quality; manifest `assets/creatures/<name>.json` + `bettermodel/<key>.bbmodel` (role asset); one `CyrusProjectAsset` kind `model`, mime `application/vnd.nxeon.rig-spec+json`, provenance (spec, compiler, engine `bettermodel@3.5.0`, model key, bbmodel/png sha256, skin size, stats, quality, warnings); `MbAssets.creatures` (customer-visible, with the spec so delivery can re-compile); creatures are not put in the mod's own pack. Idempotent like textures/sounds. No new table, no new foreign key (the existing Cyrus tables already allow kind `model`).
- **Delivery** (`lib/cyrus/creature/deliver.ts`, hooked into `afterCyrusModChange`): only with both flags; re-compiles each stored spec and refuses bytes that differ from the recorded sha256 before touching the server; ensures BetterModel (ref-counted per project; 1.21.x fails closed), writes the managed config, writes/removes this project's model files only (prefix `<namespace>_`), releases BetterModel when the last creature mod leaves, reports restart-required.
- **NxLabs page lines**: "Includes N animated custom creature(s) (...); requires the Nxeon-managed BetterModel plugin on the server (Minecraft 26.x), and players accept a resource pack on join." + "Bedrock players (Geyser/Floodgate) see the plain base mob: animated creatures are a Java Edition feature." + dropped count.
- **Host seam**: new code reaches Nxeon only through what Cyrus already used (the `GuestFs` type, `lib/db` inside the existing worker glue and sync deps, the `MbAssets`/`SvcAssetResult` types); everything else is under `lib/cyrus/creature`, `lib/cyrus/managed`, `services/modbuilder`.

Performance (no player connected): BetterModel + its libraries add about **+40 MB RSS and +1-3 s boot** (plugin load 159-166 ms after the first start; the first start also relocates the libraries). Ramp RSS at the RCON steps: 0 creatures 790 MB, 1 -> 808 MB (first tracker: class loading), 10 -> 813 MB, 50 -> 815 MB; MSPT 0.8-4.2 ms, TPS ~19.6, heap 280-400 MB. **Finding: BetterModel schedules a tracker's tick loop only when a player sees it** (`isScheduled()=false`, `playerCount()=0` throughout; animation callbacks never fire with no viewer), so these numbers are the base mobs (zombie AI) plus idle tracker objects; the real cost (per bone, per viewer: one item_display each, packets every `lerp-frame-time` 3 ticks) is unmeasured. 10 of 50 zombies died during the waits (AI in a flat world; BetterModel kept no orphan: every tracker closed). **Budget recommendation (until a real-client benchmark):** at most 25 animated creatures loaded per server and about 300 bones in any one player's view (the banshee has 10 bones), enforced by the generated plugin's config; per-creature server RAM is negligible (< 1 MB), the budget is packets/client render.

**Quality of the template models (honest):** recognisable, Minecraft-mob grade, not premium. The ghoul reads as a hooded zombie-like humanoid with a cape (good); the dire wolf reads clearly as a wolf (mane is a plain dark box; the tail is a stick); the banshee reads as a pale floating robed figure with long white hair, glowing eyes and an open mouth, but the robe stack is blocky and the head is a plain cube under a hair cap. ### Design decisions the plan did not specify
- Two RigSpec forms (template recommended, explicit for anything else) and `zod/mini` for the shared validator; the expanded spec drops `template`, the stored/returned spec keeps the small template form.
- `.bbmodel` format 5.0 (BetterModel 3.5.0 reads 4.10 and 5.0; its own demo models are both); bone tags `hi_` / `glow_`; death clip `hold` so it does not snap back before the plugin removes the mob; every death ends with a shrink to 2 %.
- Model key `<namespace>_<name>` as the file name; Nxeon writes models into `plugins/BetterModel/models` (not shipped inside the plugin jar) and removes only its own prefix.
- BetterModel's pack is hosted as ONE server-level entry (`nx_bmodel00`/`bettermodel`) after a deterministic re-zip; the mod's own pack keeps textures/sounds.
- A creature request also requests sounds; on 1.21.x the creature is a downgrade with the owner's wording, the sound set still builds.
- Managed config changes (metrics, version check, player animation, merge) as above; an owner-edited config is never overwritten.

1. Decide whether Nxeon pre-places BetterModel's runtime libraries on customer servers (pinned, from `bettermodel-3.5.0.libraries.json`) or lets the plugin download them on first start (needs outbound internet to Google's Maven mirror and maven.blamejared.com).

3. A real-client test day on 26.2: see the three creatures, their idle/walk/attack/hurt/death, the pack prompt and the sounds; then measure per-viewer cost with N creatures and set the budget.
4. Mark a 26.x version buildable (R0 lane), then `CYRUS_CREATURES=1` (portal + worker) and, with the R0 steps done, `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1`.
5. Wire the hand-off trigger (after the restart that a creature delivery requires) and choose `required` for the BetterModel pack (default false).

input.message:
**Creature pipeline built on `feature/cyrus-r6` (6 commits, 0593127834..76b5018c84). Nothing is deployed or switched on. No real client was used, so how creatures look or animate for a player is not verified.**

**What I built** (docs: "Cyrus creature pipeline (R3)")
- `lib/cyrus/creature/`: the RigSpec v1 format (Zod + JSON Schema), templates (humanoid, floating ghost "banshee", quadruped), the compiler (.bbmodel format 5.0 + skin PNG + baked clips), skin quality check, preview renderer, portal re-check, pack hand-off, server delivery.
- `lib/cyrus/managed/`: BetterModel catalog entry, library ledger, managed config. The two API jars are added to `deps.json`.
- Build service: `creatures.js`, a generated validator `creature-spec.js` (51 KB), `CREATURE_SECTION` in `prompts.js`, changes in `server.js`/`textures.js`, the Dockerfile and a `TfCreature` test fixture.
- Portal: `plan`/`request`/`sync`/router/registry/page lines. Test Flight runner gained seeds, collect and RSS per step.

**Ran:** tsc clean; 761/761 tests pass on devhost; throwaway-DB test 3/3 (one earlier failure was a plan-lookup timeout while node-2 was overloaded). Real flights on node-2 (26.2, JDK 25) all passed; results in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/creature-r3-flights-2026-10-10.json`.
**Not run:** real client, real AI build, real install on a customer server, 26.1.2/26.3.

**BetterModel:** pinned 3.5.0 (MIT, Java 25+, 1.21.4–26.3), sha256 0f983569…57ed6. It loaded all 3 compiled models; spawn, attack/hurt/death calls, despawn and clean stop all worked. Malformed models are skipped with a warning and the server is unaffected. Its pack is `plugins/BetterModel/build.zip`, models are read from `plugins/BetterModel/models`. Content is identical every boot but zip timestamps change, so the hand-off re-zips it deterministically (stable sha1, verified across two boots). The Pack Loader accepted the result on a real server.

**Performance:** BetterModel adds about 40 MB RSS and 1–3 s boot. 0/1/10/50 creatures: 790/808/813/815 MB, MSPT ≤ 4 ms. BetterModel only animates a creature while a player can see it, so the real cost (per viewer) is unmeasured. Suggested limit until a real-client test: 25 creatures per server, about 300 bones in any one player's view.

**Template quality (honest):** recognisable, plain Minecraft-mob level. The ghoul and wolf work well; the banshee reads correctly but its robe is blocky.

**Owner must:** decide whether Nxeon pre-places BetterModel's libraries (it downloads 57 files on first start); place the jar and seed the catalog; rebuild the build image; run a real-client test day; mark a 26.x version buildable; set `CYRUS_CREATURES=1` and `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1`; choose when the pack hand-off runs (it must follow a restart).

**Decisions the plan didn't specify:** two spec forms (template or explicit); zod/mini to keep the service validator small; model key `<namespace>_<name>`; one server-wide BetterModel pack entry; a creature request also asks for sounds, so 1.21.x gets the owner's downgrade message plus the sound set; death clips hold their last pose, then shrink away.

**Ran:** tsc clean; 761/761 tests pass on devhost; throwaway-DB test 3/3 (one earlier failure was a plan-lookup timeout while node-2 was overloaded). Real flights on node-2 (26.2, JDK 25) all passed; results in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/creature-r3-flights-2026-10-10.json`.
**Not run:** real client, real AI build, real install on a customer server, 26.1.2/26.3.

**BetterModel:** pinned 3.5.0 (MIT, Java 25+, 1.21.4–26.3), sha256 0f983569…57ed6. It loaded all 3 compiled models; spawn, attack/hurt/death calls, despawn and clean stop all worked. Malformed models are skipped with a warning and the server is unaffected. Its pack is `plugins/BetterModel/build.zip`, models are read from `plugins/BetterModel/models`. Content is identical every boot but zip timestamps change, so the hand-off re-zips it deterministically (stable sha1, verified across two boots). The Pack Loader accepted the result on a real server.

**Performance:** BetterModel adds about 40 MB RSS and 1–3 s boot. 0/1/10/50 creatures: 790/808/813/815 MB, MSPT ≤ 4 ms. BetterModel only animates a creature while a player can see it, so the real cost (per viewer) is unmeasured. Suggested limit until a real-client test: 25 creatures per server, about 300 bones in any one player's view.

**Template quality (honest):** recognisable, plain Minecraft-mob level. The ghoul and wolf work well; the banshee reads correctly but its robe is blocky.

**Owner must:** decide whether Nxeon pre-places BetterModel's libraries (it downloads 57 files on first start); place the jar and seed the catalog; rebuild the build image; run a real-client test day; mark a 26.x version buildable; set `CYRUS_CREATURES=1` and `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1`; choose when the pack hand-off runs (it must follow a restart).

**Decisions the plan didn't specify:** two spec forms (template or explicit); zod/mini to keep the service validator small; model key `<namespace>_<name>`; one server-wide BetterModel pack entry; a creature request also asks for sounds, so 1.21.x gets the owner's downgrade message plus the sound set; death clips hold their last pose, then shrink away.
